algorithm: Autoregressive next-token cross-entropy over discretized 'motion-aware dynamics' tokens (VQ-VAE visual dynamics + RQ-VAE motion dynamics), plus a supervised continuous-action regression head (Action Decoder); combined loss L = Lar + lambda*Laction
hand: Inspire dexterous hand (paired, main real-robot eval); cross-embodiment eval uses 22-DoF SharpaWave Dexterous Hand
arm: Unitree G1 humanoid dual arm (2x7 DoF arm joints)
success_criterion: Qualitative per-task description judged by experimenters (e.g. 'Success is achieved if the apple is successfully placed into the plate'); no numeric threshold in metres/seconds given for any task
headline_value: 85.0% SR on Pick and Place (Table 2); per-task SR ranges 70-95% across 6 real tasks, best or tied-best on 5 of 6
human_data: EgoAtlas: 343K trajectories / 89.72M image-action pairs across 8 sources (H2O, OAKINK, PH2D, ARCTIC, EgoDex, HoloAssist, ActionNet, 'Our Enhanced Data'), mixing human wearable-capture data (Manus Quantum Metagloves + VIVE trackers) and vision-based human datasets with teleoperated robot data
note_gaps: Action chunk length disagrees between Sec 4.3 (30 steps) and App D.2 (32) with no reconciliation given; lambda weighting in the combined loss not stated; no simulator/domain-randomization or contact/penetration treatment appears anywhere (real-world-only, no-sim, no-code paper).
backbone: Prismatic-7B initialization: SigLIP + DINOv2 hybrid vision encoder, LLaMA-2 7B LLM (decoder-only Transformer, 32 sequential blocks)
action_head: Autoregressive discrete dynamics tokens (VQ-VAE visual + RQ-VAE motion, 44 tokens total) decoded by a separate Action Decoder (multi-head attention pooling over dynamics+visual features, proprioception via 2-layer MLP, linear projection) into continuous fingertip-space actions
pretrain_data: EgoAtlas: 343K trajectories / 89.72M image-action pairs across 8 sources (H2O, OAKINK, PH2D, ARCTIC, EgoDex, HoloAssist, ActionNet, 'Our Enhanced Data')
dexterous_evidence: For hardware platform, we use a Unitree G1 humanoid robot equipped with a pair of Inspire 6-DoF dexterous hands for fine-grained manipulation. (Sec 5.1)
